app.title: Dhofar Municipality — Self Service
app.subtitle: Citizen self-service portal
home.heading: Welcome to Dhofar Municipality
home.lead: Choose the service you need. Every service is available in Arabic and English.
home.newRequestHint: Sign in with your phone number to submit and track a request
home.loginHint: View your previous requests and answer enquiries
home.privacyBody: Your session closes automatically after two minutes of inactivity and your data is cleared from this screen. Please press End session before you leave.
login.heading: Sign in
login.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your phone
login.expired: The code has expired. Please request a new one.
dashboard.heading: My requests
dashboard.emptyHint: Start by submitting a new request.
wizard.routedTo: This request will be sent to: {target}
wizard.descriptionHint: Describe your request in detail (at least 20 characters)
wizard.attachmentsHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG — up to 5 files, 10 MB each
wizard.attachmentsRequired: This service requires at least one supporting document
wizard.submitting: Submitting… please do not close this screen
receipt.heading: Your request has been received
receipt.lead: Keep this reference number to follow your request.
receipt.scanHint: Scan the code to follow your request from your phone
details.heading: Request details
details.replyHint: Add the information the municipality asked for
details.replyClosed: This request cannot be replied to in its current status.
track.heading: Track a request
track.lead: Enter the reference number you received when you submitted the request.
track.label: Reference number
track.notFound: No request was found with that reference number.
track.privacyNote: For privacy, public tracking shows the general status only. Sign in to see full details.
idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: Your session will close in {seconds} seconds to protect your privacy.
idle.expired: Your session ended and your data was cleared from this screen.
error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the values entered are not valid.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
error.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is temporarily locked. Please try later.
error.OTP_INVALID: The verification code is incorrect or has expired.
error.OTP_LOCKED: Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new code.
error.OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait before requesting another code.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this resource.
error.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: This page has expired. Please try again.
error.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
error.SERVICE_INACTIVE: This service is not currently available.
error.REQUEST_IS_TERMINAL: This request is closed and cannot be changed.
error.REPLY_NOT_ALLOWED: Information cannot be added to this request right now.
error.DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION: This request has already been submitted.
error.INVALID_ASSIGNEE: This request cannot be assigned to that staff member.
error.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Unsupported file type. Only PDF, JPEG and PNG are accepted.
error.ATTACHMENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You cannot attach more than 5 files.
error.ATTACHMENT_REQUIRED: This service requires a supporting document.
error.ATTACHMENT_UNAVAILABLE: This file is not available for download.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The submitted data is too large.
